# NemlAI (Agent Plugins 1.0.0)

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_agent_packages.py in the NemlAI repo; edit the sources there, not this file. -->

An [Agent Plugins 1.0.0](https://agent-plugins.org/specification) plugin: the `nemlai`
skill (`skills/nemlai/`) and the NemlAI MCP server (`mcp.json`, Streamable HTTP at `https://nemlai.milops.org/mcp`).

`mcp.json` has no token: the spec forbids environment variables in headers. Clients sign in with
OAuth (the server publishes its OAuth metadata; you approve on NemlAI's consent page, **Giv
adgang**). If your client has no OAuth, configure the server with your NemlAI token instead:
`pipx install nemlai`, `nemlai login`, then `nemlai mcp install <client>`
(claude-code, codex, hermes, openclaw) or `nemlai mcp config <client>` to print the config.
